recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the Administration complete the independent and impartial review of the Department without further delay and rationalize the network of United Nations information centres on the basis of objective evidence, taking into account mandates, the needs of developing countries and least developed countries, countries’ population size, potential audience reach, workload, host-country support and communication priorities, including through the redeployment of resources where appropriate. 10.3. Inadequate discharge of responsibilities for website approval and review
